text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens (dark green, flat, ruffled arugula-like leaves with thin stems) piled in a loose mound in the upper center of the plate, with some leaves draped toward the lower center; slightly glossy with dressing, moist, holds a loose heap shape, covers roughly 35% of the plate width area | 60
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted potato-like pieces, about 2-3 cm each, golden-brown with darker browned and slightly charred edges, matte to lightly oily surface, firm and holding shape, arranged in a loose cluster along the left edge of the greens | 110
ITEM 3 | Small orange-yellow fruit pieces (chunks about 1-1.5 cm, bright orange with translucent, slightly juicy look), scattered among and beneath the greens in the center | 15
ITEM 4 | Dark blueberry-like small round berries, roughly 1 cm, deep purple-black with slight sheen, three or four scattered among the greens | 5
ITEM 5 | Walnut-like nut pieces, light tan with irregular lobed texture, one or two visible near the top center of the greens | 5
ITEM 6 | Reddish-brown dressing or sauce, thin and glossy, visible as small drops and smears on the greens and the plate edge at top left | 5
